15.1_catalog.vue_complexity: items/ tree = 12 root files + composer/ + wizard/ + variation/ + addon/ + extra/, total ~3981 LOC for items only
15.1_catalog.verdict: Layered properly (Controller → Service → Resource). ItemController correctly uses `AdminController::authorizeBranchScope()` for branch_id param. CatalogStudioComponent.vue is well-instrumented with aria-labels. Composer module has its own route-group gating (`permission:catalog.compose`, `permission:catalog.publish`).

15.2_stock.verdict: Smallest sub-system, cleanest layering. Both routes gated by permission middleware (controller-level + route-level). Z-3 i18n heal landed.

15.3_reports.service_layer: DashboardService (492 LOC — DIRTY, deferred), OrderService.salesReportOverview, AnalyticService
15.3_reports.verdict: DashboardService session-A WIP (deferred). DashboardController is thin and well-gated (`permission:dashboard` on all 15 endpoints). SalesReportController is gated `permission:sales-report`. Reports/Analytics inherit from same OrderService used by POS — single-source-of-truth ordering. Wave 3c TZ-aware boundary heal (commit 148dbebce) visible in DashboardService L72-82, L362, L425.

15.4_settings.verdict: Massive surface (~20 controllers under /admin/setting/*). Each individually gated `permission:settings` at controller level. Route-group inheritance via `throttle:admin-mutation`. KioskSetupController has GAP-19-2 heal documented — both `index` and `update` gated.

15.5_users_permissions.verdict: Spatie RBAC matrix model. AdministratorController gates 5 distinct verbs (administrators_*). PermissionController M-R3-P0-A heal landed (commit visible in inline comment L27-33). RoleController index gated `permission:settings|employees` (alternation OK). AdministratorRequest M-R3-P0-E heal blocks non-superadmin from minting branch_id=0 admin (L83-91).

15.6_coupons_promos.verdict: CouponController is exemplary — 5 verbs, 5 distinct permissions (`coupons`, `coupons_create`, `coupons_edit`, `coupons_delete`, `coupons_show`) + CouponChanged event dispatch via `dispatchCouponChanged()` private helper for create/update/delete/toggle. Branch-scope-aware via Coupon model `branch_scope` cast. OfferController identical pattern.

15.7_daily_ops.verdict: Mixed quality. MyOrderDetailsController has NO permission middleware (see Security/RED findings). TableOrderController gated `permission:table-orders`. KdsSyncController has its own test (KdsSyncControllerTest). DeliveryBoyCashSessionController exemplary (read vs mutation split via _show suffix). OnlineOrderController not yet reviewed but has tests.

AC-1_inheritance_pattern_consistent.title: AdminController base class universally extended
AC-1_inheritance_pattern_consistent.evidence: All 90 controllers under app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ extend `AdminController` (count via grep). Base class exposes `authorizeBranchScope()` and `authorizeWritableBranchScope()` helpers. Pattern is consistent.
AC-1_inheritance_pattern_consistent.verdict: OK — but `authorizeBranchScope` is only invoked in 20 controllers (grep -rln). 70 controllers extend the base but never call the helpers, relying on global BranchScope on models instead.

AC-2_service_layer_separation_OK.title: Service layer separation respected
AC-2_service_layer_separation_OK.evidence: Controllers delegate to *Service classes (ItemService, OrderService, DashboardService, CouponService, etc.). Controllers contain `try/catch + Resource wrapping` only. Business logic in services.
AC-2_service_layer_separation_OK.verdict: Clean. No fat controllers. DashboardController = 186 LOC of pure delegation.

AC-3_test_coverage_ratio_critical.title: Admin feature tests cover 12.6% of controllers
AC-3_test_coverage_ratio_critical.evidence: tests/Feature/Admin/ = 11 files (counting POS subdir as 1). 87 PHP controllers. Tests target: Availability, DeliveryBoyCashSession, EmployeeRequestAuthorize, IngredientControllerAuthz, ItemRequestBarcodeKdsStation, KdsSyncController, PaymentTerminalController, PermissionControllerIndexAuthz, StockRuptureDashboard×2, POS subdir.
AC-3_test_coverage_ratio_critical.verdict: Heavyweight surface (catalog, settings, reports, RBAC) is under-tested. Most heal commits don't ship regression sentinels for admin paths. V1.0.2 P1.

AC-4_source_enum_kiosk_conflated_with_ap.title: Source enum has no KIOSK constant — KIOSK orders bucket into APP=10
AC-4_source_enum_kiosk_conflated_with_ap.evidence: app/Enums/Source.php declares WEB=5, APP=10, POS=15. DashboardService::channelStatistics() L442 comment: `$app = ...; // Utilisé pour le kiosk`. Channel breakdown chart labels: ['Web','Kiosk/App','POS'] — admits the conflation.
AC-4_source_enum_kiosk_conflated_with_ap.verdict: Architecture leak between metrics layer and source taxonomy. KIOSK orders cannot be reported distinctly from mobile-app orders. Likely a deliberate V1 simplification (single Le Cayenne resto, no mobile app yet), but documentation-grade gap. V1.0.2 to add KIOSK=20.

AC-5_vue_admin_dashboard_widget_count.title: Admin dashboard composed of 15 Vue widgets
AC-5_vue_admin_dashboard_widget_count.evidence: resources/js/components/admin/dashboard/ = 15 files (AuditTrailComponent, ChannelStatsComponent, OverviewComponent, RealtimeReportComponent, SlaAlertsComponent, StockLowAlertsWidget, LastZReportWidget, etc.). Each maps 1:1 to a DashboardController endpoint.

AC-6_dashboardservice_dirty_session_A_de.title: DashboardService.php is session-A in-flight — read-only observe per mandate
AC-6_dashboardservice_dirty_session_A_de.evidence: File is in git status as `app/Services/DashboardService.php M` per master prompt. NOT scoring its internals; only observed call-sites (DashboardController = sole consumer + ActionLog model touches it).
AC-6_dashboardservice_dirty_session_A_de.verdict: Defer grading until session-A commits. Surface call-site pattern: DashboardController + ActionLog (audit). No other consumers.
